remarks: Welcome to Norwalk! Impeccable 2 bedroom, 2 full bath condo in the desirable Carriage House! Top floor unit with vaulted ceilings and lots of natural light. Kitchen has great counter space, plenty of cabinets, double sink and gas range. Open floor plan with living room and dining room combo. Very spacious primary bedroom with en-suite bath and a huge (really!) walk-in closet. There is a second bedroom and another full bath. Gleaming floors, multiple ceiling fans, great closet space, storage unit on the same floor. Reserved parking in the garage and elevator access. The picturesque grounds of the Carriage House are perfect for strolling along the Five Mile River, or you can head out on foot or bicycle to local shopping and dining along Route 1. Minutes to I95, Metro North Rowayton and Darien stations. An easy 55 minutes to NYC.
